title: DatasetProfile
description: A versioned gold set or retrieval corpus snapshot (ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §7; Master Specification Chapter 17 §14.6).
$comment: Required fields are exactly ztax_gateway.production_registries.DatasetProfile. data_class is a free string there (fixtures use INTERNAL) rather than a PRIV-001 class; it is left a non-empty string here until that vocabulary is settled, and privacy_class is the PRIV-001 form. source, rights and intended_use are AIGOV-001 §7 fields the Python dataclass does not yet carry.
